summary: Stores a per-entry contact-constraint value and marks the entry active. Given an entry index a2 and a value a3, the function writes a3 into the float slot at dword index a2 + 1841 of the float-typed object and sets the byte flag at byte offset a2 + 7360 to 1, then returns a2. The value and flag live in two parallel indexed arrays of the same object.

operations.description: Entry selection: a2 indexes the constraint slot; the value lands at dword index a2 + 1841 and its active byte flag at byte offset a2 + 7360.
Write the constraint value a3 into this[a2 + 1841].
Set the byte at offset a2 + 7360 to 1, marking the entry active.
Called by WheelDynamicsInit (0x0043E230) to set one wheel contact constraint during wheel-dynamics initialisation.
